title: Sole Source Award to Phillips Corporation
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.USMC.MARCORP I&L.COMMANDER
detail_text: Marine Depot Maintenance Command has a requirement for the ‘cartridge filter exchange set’ for the EOS M-400 machines is needed to maintain production readiness, provide the engineer techs the proper material to safely clean out each 3D Printing machine, and create/deliver items to customers in a timely manner. This item includes an F9 cartridge filter, transport container, PTFE seals, and 7 KG of quartz sand. The Government is awarding a purchase order to Phillips Federal (EOS division) on a sole source basis.
